map.「解读血清补体C3/C4水平变化在自身免疫病(尤其SLE)疾病活动评估中的意义」: This tool performs professional calculation and outputs results based on input parameters for "interpreting serum complement C3/C4 level changes in autoimmune disease (especially SLE) activity assessment".
map.SLE重度活动、弥漫增殖性LN: Severe SLE activity, diffuse proliferative LN
map.：SLE疾病活动敏感标志，常先于临床复发出现(提前数周): : sensitive marker of SLE activity, often precedes clinical relapse (weeks ahead)
map.：C3/C4↓ + dsDNA↑ = SLE复发的最强预测组合: : C3/C4 down + dsDNA up = strongest predictor combination of SLE relapse
map.：C3持续低水平提示肾脏受累(狼疮性肾炎): : persistently low C3 suggests renal involvement (lupus nephritis)
map.：治疗有效的标志，但迟于临床症状改善: : marker of effective treatment, but lags clinical improvement
map.：C1q/C2/C4缺乏可导致SLE样综合征(需鉴别): : C1q/C2/C4 deficiency can cause SLE-like syndrome (needs differentiation)
map.提示：补体是SLE活动度监测的核心实验室指标。建议每1-3月监测C3/C4，疾病: Note: complement is a core lab marker for SLE activity monitoring. Monitor C3/C4 every 1-3 months, shortened to every 2-4 weeks in active disease. Low complement needs ruling out infection (especially bacterial/sepsis) and reduced hepatic synthesis. Persistently very low C4 (<0.05 g/L) may be congenital C4 deficiency. Cryoglobulinemia typically shows markedly low C4 with normal or mildly low C3. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：补体 C3/C4 与活动评估: 📚 In-depth: Complement C3/C4 and Activity Assessment
map.C3 0.5(低)、C4 0.05(低)、dsDNA 强阳、蛋白尿+关节炎 →: C3 0.5 (low), C4 0.05 (low), dsDNA strongly positive, proteinuria + arthritis -> high activity score, suggests lupus activity especially nephritis, needs immunosuppression.
map.C3 0.7、C4 0.08、dsDNA 阴性、急性感染 → 感染相关补体消耗，: C3 0.7, C4 0.08, dsDNA negative, acute infection -> infection-related complement consumption, recheck after anti-infection.
map.C3/C4 降低+dsDNA 升高+临床（肾/皮疹/浆膜）组合算活动分；补体回升: C3/C4 low + dsDNA high + clinical (renal/rash/serosal) combination counts as activity score; complement rebound often predicts remission.
map.感染、冷球蛋白血症、先天缺陷也可低补体，结合背景与动态变化解读。: Infection, cryoglobulinemia, congenital deficiency can also lower complement; interpret with background and dynamics.
